146 def verify_token(token: str, token_type: str = "access") -> dict[str, Any] | None:
147     """
148     Verify token signature, expiration, and type
149 
150     This function provides comprehensive token validation including:
151     - Signature verification using HS256 algorithm
152     - Expiration time checking
153     - Token type validation to prevent token confusion attacks
154 
155     Token type validation ensures that access tokens cannot be used as refresh
156     tokens and vice versa, preventing token confusion attacks where an attacker
157     might try to use a short-lived access token in place of a long-lived refresh
158     token or vice versa.
159 
160     Args:
161         token: JWT token string to verify
162         token_type: Expected token type ("access" or "refresh")
163 
164     Returns:
165         Decoded payload if valid and type matches, None otherwise
166 
167     Security Notes:
168         - Returns None for any validation failure (signature, expiration, or type)
169         - Token type mismatch is treated as a security violation
170         - All tokens must include a "type" field in their payload
171     """
172     payload = decode_token(token)
173 
174     if payload is None:
175         return None
176 
177     # Validate token type matches expected type
178     # This prevents token confusion attacks
179     if payload.get("type") != token_type:
180         return None
181 
182     return payload
